method.labelBounds: Cytoscape renderedBoundingBox: includeNodes=false, includeEdges=false, includeLabels=true, includeOverlays=false, includeUnderlays=false; includes wrap/padding/rotation
method.overlaps: All on-canvas label AABBs have strict positive intersection; conservative for rotated edge labels
method.exposed: Whole label box inside viewport and not intersecting visible detail/AI dialog/minimap rectangles; existing translucent scrims do not remove visual labels
method.stable: Camera and node animations stopped; viewport, node count and document geometry stable for 350ms. Earlier explicitly retained desktop/path measurements used camera stability 220ms plus elapsed interaction/render time.
limits: Node circles, evidence badges and edge strokes crossing text are not counted as text-text collisions.
AI mobile full sheet intentionally covers the map; after close the same selected-company label returns.
Mobile zoom/pan was exercised after dismissing the modal detail sheet, then Samsung was selected again.
Caption counts include on-canvas labels; exposed counts exclude whole-box viewport clipping and overlay cover.
Before screenshots were reused; no new numeric before collision count is claimed.
URL slop scanner sees the unauthenticated login surface, not the protected graph.

diagnostics.abortContext: Aborted requests were observed during route/theme changes and development HMR. They were not individually triaged; no JavaScript page errors were observed.

build.warning: Main JavaScript chunk 1555.21 kB exceeds the 500 kB warning threshold; no bundle optimization or warning suppression was added in this label repair.

resolvedTypecheckFailures: Cytoscape runtime useCache option is absent from BoundingBoxOptions; a structurally typed options variable preserves the real renderer behavior without a cast.
StylesheetJsonBlock may use style or css; the regression consumer now narrows both forms and keeps only actual string label mappings.
verification.slopSurfaceLimit: Unauthenticated URL scans do not prove the protected graph surface; authenticated browser captures and Cytoscape measurements are separate evidence.

additionalDarkZoomPan.limit: The existing modal detail sheet blocks graph gestures; mobile pan is exercised after sheet dismissal. At zoom 1.125 the sheet and viewport can cover or clip all complete issue captions even while seven issue captions remain on the canvas.
